notes.title: Version 1.16 Update
notes.content:
Fixed issue of corrupt save files observed in certain environments.
1. Improved file writing procedure to prevent corruption.
2. Save files now have 3 versions of backup copies (savedata.sav.bak ~ savedata.sav.bak3).

notes.title: Version 1.15 Update
notes.content: 1. In-App purchase terminated. You can still play the game as before.

notes.title: Version 1.14 Update
notes.content: 1. We have terminated in-app crystal purchase. You can still use crystals already bought before they expire (150 days).

notes.title: Version 1.13 Update
notes.content:
1. Fixed the issue where the game won’t run on 32bit Windows.
2. Fixed the bug where some tabs remain unavailable occasionally.

notes.title: Version 1.12 Update
notes.content:
Fixed bugs on unlocking achievements. There are several occasions where achievements are not unlocked after characters have been summoned. If you are affected by this bug, achievements will be unlocked automatically when you run the game next time.
 Adjusted game balance. Some summon costs are now lower, and skills are more likely to be acquired.
 Other minor fixes.

notes.title: Version 1.11 Update!!!
notes.content:
- Abolished reset on summon. Summoning will no longer reset your gold, magic power, and hired units.
- Added unit skills. Units can now learn skills.
- Added item “Magic Lamp” and “Cat Teaser”.
- Added skip and auto functionalities in special episodes.
- Improved reliability of saving. Save files are less likely to become corrupted.
- Added compatibility with 32-bit Windows.


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31194108/813adb266f84aee6a9f50e04e22c0dfb818c199d.jpg
(1) Summon Support Button
Units can help with the purchase of summon items. This button appears when units have acquired relevant skills.

(2) Unit Skill
Units will learn skills if hired by a certain amount.

(3) Item Button
Touching Monmusu may cause them to drop some item (once per day maximum).

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31194108/d6b547181af835fd9ffa3e8f558490b7bad7e218.jpg

(4) Summon Support Unit
Units become grey. They will stop producing anything and you cannot hire additional units until summon support is over.

(5) Item “Magic Lamp” in Use
The green bar indicates remaining time left.
When “Magic Lamp” is used, the per-second production rate of each unit becomes visible.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31194108/69f1a480f38a0395a9240bdc4f061ab6b9b0497c.jpg

(6) Summon Support Unit
As shown the purchase time of summon item is reduced. 
Summon support can be ended by clicking “Call back” button and units will return to normal.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31194108/2171a5626000d85199342927815fd170721c40eb.jpg

(7) Skip Button and Auto Mode Button
Added skip button and auto button to dialogue scenes.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31194108/79f19e89daa7a9a8d84ec73c1ce9599684586a57.jpg

(8) Game Version

(9) Save Folder Button
Clicking this button will bring up the save file folder.

notes.title: Version 1.10 update
notes.content:
Version 1.10
1. Added a setting screen. You can access the setting screen by clicking the SETTING button located at the bottom right corner of UNITS tab.
2. Improved graphic design of UI.
3. Fixed strange behaviors in boost sessions when favorability rating reaches maximum.
4. Improved reliability of saving procedure (to prevent corrupted save files).
